title: The slice the aggregate hid
caption: Gender Shades audit of a commercial face classifier (Buolamwini & Gebru 2018): error rates by demographic group. Dark-skinned females carry a 43.1× error rate over light-skinned males — invisible under a high aggregate accuracy.

title: 100× the collection for a 1% subgroup
caption: Bounding a rare subgroup's error to 1pp at 95% confidence needs ~10,000 of its images. Random sampling expects 1,000,000 total images to yield them; recruiting the subgroup directly needs only its 10,000 — a 100× multiplier.
